name: bracket
title: Parametric L-bracket: base plate, bolt holes, tapered web, gusset rib
description: A realistic mounting bracket built from the construction API. The base plate and the vertical web are extrusions of parameter-backed sketch profiles, the stiffening rib is a triangular gusset tying the web to the plate, and the two bolt holes are subtracted cylinders whose positions are pinned by constraints. The bracket bolts onto a mounting slab that is rendered but excluded from simulation: the named SimMesh below meshes only the bracket domain.
